reports.method: Fresh processes connect to a local Unix socket, print its greeting, and exit. One warmup per runtime excluded; alternate runtime order. helloMs ends when the parent observes the child's received greeting; exitMs includes process shutdown. This is a loader/socket floor, not the full production client or a model request.
